scope: One exact-ID Tool subcategory correction; no supplemental role or tag claims.
reviewRecord: Root independently read the full pinned Rock thrownhammer and Rock hammer articles and exact item states. The thrownhammer own definition explicitly names Slayer equipment and its gargoyle finishing operation. Its ranged reach and consumption are differences from the reusable rock hammer, without changing its primary Slayer-tool function. Independent exact152 Tool review confirmed this mismatch.

[[File:Rock thrownhammer detail.png|left|160px]]
A '''rock thrownhammer''' is [[Slayer#Slayer equipment|slayer equipment]] that is required to kill [[gargoyle]]s. Unlike the [[rock hammer]], the rock thrownhammer can be used to finish off gargoyles without having to do so within melee distance. This is useful for finishing off gargoyles when ranging from a safespot, or when finishing off [[Dawn]]. Since they are consumed upon usage, players should buy enough thrownhammers for their slayer task.
